== Summary ==
[[Shannon Baksa]] in costume as Mara Jade at [[DecipherCon 1999]], 13 November 1999. Head-and-shoulders crop of Decipher's photograph sat63, whose full frame is [[:File:DecipherCon 1999 Mara Jade autograph.jpg]]. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Bill Bisco, 25 October 2026. Decipher's sat63 caption addresses her as Mara: "Mara, put the lightsaber down, please. I just want your autograph." Baksa was Decipher's Mara Jade guest and appeared in full costume on the Saturday.<ref name="sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>
